tpms.when: 2014–2015 with the tire pressure SET (reset) switch
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the label on the driver's door jamb, checking them before driving or after the car has sat a few hours.
Park the car and turn the ignition to ON.
Press and hold the tire pressure SET (reset) switch until the tire pressure light blinks three times, then let go.
Leave the car sitting for a few minutes so the system can finish storing the new pressures.
tpms.note: Do this again after adjusting pressures, rotating tires or fitting new tires, since the system remembers whatever pressures are in the tires when you press the switch. Pressing the switch does not turn the light off if a tire is still low. If the light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault and a Scion or Toyota dealer needs to check it.
